title: CharSim: code and data for "Character determines incident: director-free language model agents for testing fictional characters"
description: Source code, prompts, simulated scenes, judge answers, measures, statistics and analysis scripts of the article "Character determines incident: director-free language model agents for testing fictional characters" (submitted to PeerJ Computer Science). The text of The Good Earth and the files derived from it are not redistributed; SHA-256 checksums verify files rebuilt from a copy of the book.
